title: Story Settings
landsLaterBody: This tab isn't built yet. Nothing here is configurable.
unavailableBody: Something went wrong loading this device's story list. Go back and try again.
uninitialized: This story has no settings yet
uninitializedBody: Settings are written when a story finishes setup. Finish the wizard for this story, or reset its settings to defaults.
corrupt: This story's settings can't be read
corruptBody: Nothing here can be edited safely. Open this story from your library to reset its settings to defaults.

save.failed: Couldn't save your changes. They're still here — try again.
save.stale: Saved, but this screen is out of date. Reload to see the current values.
save.unreadable: Saved, but this story's settings can no longer be read. Reset them from your library to keep editing.
save.unsavedBody: You have unsaved changes on this screen. Save them, discard them, or stay here.

confirm.title: Changes to how the story is written
confirm.body: These take effect from the next turn.

consequence.composerWrapPov: Affects how new user input in Do / Say / Think modes is rendered. Existing entries stay as-saved.

missingStory: This story could not be loaded.

swap.title: Change embedding model
swap.pickBody: Pick a model to switch this story to. The current model can't be selected.
swap.reindexHint: Rebuilds every vector under the new model. Crash-safe; resumable.
swap.keepHint: Stay on the current model. Nothing changes.
swap.optionsBody: Choose how to proceed with this switch.
swap.relabelHint: Update the recorded model without rebuilding any vectors.
swap.relabelDisclaimer: This is your assertion that the underlying model is unchanged. If it differs, retrieval quality degrades silently.
swap.resumeBody: Switching this story to {{model}} was interrupted, likely by a crash or force-quit. Resume to pick up where it left off, or cancel to keep this story on its current model.

reindexConfirm.title: Re-index this story?
reindexConfirm.body_one: Re-embeds all {{count}} entry in this story with {{model}}. Nothing is deleted — each embedding is replaced as it is rebuilt.
reindexConfirm.body_other: Re-embeds all {{count}} entries in this story with {{model}}. Nothing is deleted — each embedding is replaced as it is rebuilt.
reindexConfirm.bodyUnknownCount: Re-embeds every entry in this story with {{model}}. Nothing is deleted — each embedding is replaced as it is rebuilt.
reindexConfirm.cancelSemantics: You can cancel while it runs. Cancelling keeps the entries already rebuilt and queues the rest.

upgrade.title: Newer embedding model available
upgrade.body: This story embeds with {{current}}. The app default is now {{target}}. Upgrading re-indexes this story on the new model.
upgrade.keepFailed: Couldn't record that choice while generation is running. It will ask again next time.
upgrade.keepError: Couldn't record that choice. It will ask again next time.

about.heading: About
about.intro: What the story is — identity and metadata.
about.title: Title
about.descriptionHint: Shown on the library card. Never sent to the AI.
about.statusDraft: Drafts finish in the wizard; the library status can't change here.
about.favoriteHint: Favorites float to the top of the library.

invalid.accentColor: The accent color isn't a valid hex value
invalid.draftStory: Drafts finish in the wizard, so these changes can't be saved here

generation.suggestionsHint: Offer tappable next-turn suggestions after each AI reply.

resetUnavailable.missing: This story has no mode recorded yet.
resetUnavailable.unrecognized: This story's mode isn't one this version recognises.

generation.resetBody: Replaces the list with a fresh copy of the defaults for this story's mode. Your edits to these categories are discarded.
generation.deleteBody: Chips already suggested under this category keep rendering, labelled (removed).
generation.composerModesHint: Offer Do / Say / Think / Free wrapping in the composer.
generation.composerModesCreative: Composer modes are hidden in creative mode — you write prose directly.

composerModesUnavailable.missing: Composer modes are adventure-only, and this story has no mode recorded yet.
composerModesUnavailable.unrecognized: Composer modes are adventure-only, and this story's mode isn't one this version recognises.

generation.composerWrapPovHint: How Do / Say / Think wrap what you type. Independent of the narration voice.
generation.composerWrapPovNeedsModes: Applies only when the composer offers Do / Say / Think.

invalid.empty-list: At least one category is required

models.heading: Models
models.intro: Overrides pin a model for this story. Anything not overridden follows App Settings › Profiles.

broken.no-profile-assigned: App default: no profile assigned in App Settings
broken.profile-missing: App default: the assigned profile was deleted
broken.provider-missing: App default: the profile's provider is missing

models.overrideProviderMissing: This override's provider was removed. Clear it or pick again.
models.noProviders: Add a provider in App Settings to pin models.
models.providerWriteFailed: Couldn't save that to the provider. Try again.

memory.heading: Embedder

reason.modelMissing: The current embedding model is missing or was removed.

memory.swapPending: A switch is already pending for this story.
memory.busy: An embedder operation is already running for this story.
memory.actionFailed: That didn't work. Please try again.
memory.relabelBlocked: Can't relabel while a switch is in progress.
memory.swapPendingBody: Switching this story to {{model}} was interrupted. Nothing is being embedded until you resume or cancel.
memory.cancelTooLate: The switch finished before it could be cancelled.
memory.relabelDimMismatch: These vectors are stored at a different size than that model reads. Re-index this story instead — relabelling would leave every embedding unreadable.

knobs.thresholdHint: Tokens of prose per chapter before it closes.
knobs.autoCloseHint: Off: the threshold is guidance only and you close chapters yourself.
knobs.fullChapterHint: Send the whole current chapter verbatim. At the threshold that is about {{tokens}} tokens per turn.
knobs.fullChapterHintPlain: Send the whole current chapter verbatim.
knobs.partialBufferHint: Entries of the current chapter sent in partial mode.
knobs.partialBufferIgnored: Ignored while the full chapter is in the buffer.
knobs.protectedBufferHint: Floor of recent entries; a fresh chapter fills from earlier ones to reach it.
knobs.classifierContextHint: Trailing entries the fallback classifier sees. Minimum 2 — the action and reply it reads.
knobs.cadenceOverlap_one: {{count}} turn of coverage overlap with the partial buffer.
knobs.cadenceOverlap_other: {{count}} turns of coverage overlap with the partial buffer.
knobs.cadenceWarning: Cadence exceeds the partial buffer — turns can leave the window unclassified.
knobs.budgetsHint: Token budgets per type. Hard partitions — unused tokens don't spill over.

keywordModeHint.boost: A keyword match raises the row's score; the ranker still decides.
keywordModeHint.inject: A keyword match seats the lore or entity directly, within a budget.

knobs.budgetShareHint: Largest share of each type's budget keyword matches may fill (0 to 1).
knobs.scanEntriesHint: Trailing entries scanned besides the current action.
knobs.cascadeHint: Rescan injected rows for further matches.
knobs.cascadeMaxDepthNeedsCascade: Turn on Cascade to set a depth.

invalid.threshold: Chapter threshold must be a whole number of at least 1
invalid.partialBuffer: Partial chapter buffer must be a whole number of at least 0
invalid.protectedBuffer: Protected buffer must be a whole number of at least 0
invalid.cadence: Classifier cadence must be a whole number of at least 1
invalid.budget: Every retrieval budget must be a whole number of at least 0
invalid.budgetShare: Budget share must be a number between 0 and 1
invalid.scanEntries: Scan depth must be a whole number of at least 1
invalid.cascadeDepth: Max cascade depth must be a whole number of at least 1
